decisions.reason: As a core resin-injection unit tied to the firm's stated innovation path and supported by earlier visible commitment, management is likely to continue justifying and backing it rather than withdraw it now.
This product is likewise a core process-equipment launch with dedicated presentation and accumulated investment, so escalation of commitment and normal industrial product patience favor retention.

The manual airless spray gun fits the firm's traditional core offering and installed sales-service structure, making management more inclined to keep it on the market than reverse course after several years.
Because this is a multi-model product line in a central technology area, the firm's public and resource commitment is especially visible, which strongly reduces the likelihood of withdrawal.

The data logger is more adjacent to the firm's mechanical core and thus somewhat easier to cut, but its role in innovative application technology still gives management reason to persist unless results clearly disappoint.
